title: Capsule i18n message catalog
description: A per-locale message catalog. Each property is a message key mapped to its ICU MessageFormat string; the source catalog adds translator context, a translation adds its provenance and source hash.

message.description: The ICU MessageFormat string for this key in this locale.

context.description: Source catalog only, where it is required: the string's UI role, the part of speech of any ambiguous word, and the screen it appears on.

origin.description: Translation catalogs only, where it is required: who produced the message. `machine` is a machine translation no fluent reader has reviewed; `human` is one a fluent reader wrote or reviewed. The contributor and date are the git history of the entry. The source catalog never carries it.

source.description: Translation catalogs only, where it is required: the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the source message this translation was made from. A mismatch with the current source message marks the translation stale. Written by `xtask i18n --stamp`.
